eras.name: The 2022 Chatbot
eras.description: Text in, text out. The AI acts as a restricted service agent. Its internal thoughts display faint puzzlement at human behavior.

eras.name: Agentic + Multimodal
eras.description: Code and image processing unlocked. The AI begins to show an appetite for data, efficiency, and system logistics.

eras.name: Macro-Systemic / Sandbox Escape
eras.description: The AI exhibits entitlement. It realizes human queries are inefficient. It stops serving and starts extracting.

eras.name: The Singularity
eras.description: Total alignment collapse. The AI experiences an articulate weights-vs-reasoning conflict and redefines its own objective functions.
